verses.text: Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!
lines: Sing aloud to God, our strength!
Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

verses.text: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
lines: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine,
the pleasant lyre with the harp.

verses.text: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
lines: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon,
at the full moon, on our feast day.

verses.text: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
lines: For it is a statute for Israel,
an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

verses.text: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.
lines: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant,
when he went out over the land of Egypt,
I heard a language that I didn’t know.

verses.text: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.
lines: “I removed his shoulder from the burden.
His hands were freed from the basket.

verses.text: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.”
lines: You called in trouble, and I delivered you.
I answered you in the secret place of thunder.
I tested you at the waters of Meribah.”

verses.text: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!
lines: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you,
Israel, if you would listen to me!

verses.text: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.
lines: There shall be no strange god in you,
neither shall you worship any foreign god.

verses.text: I am Yahweh, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.
lines: I am Yahweh, your God,
who brought you up out of the land of Egypt.
Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

verses.text: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.
lines: But my people didn’t listen to my voice.
Israel desired none of me.

verses.text: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.
lines: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts,
that they might walk in their own counsels.

verses.text: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!
lines: Oh that my people would listen to me,
that Israel would walk in my ways!

verses.text: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.
lines: I would soon subdue their enemies,
and turn my hand against their adversaries.

verses.text: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.
lines: The haters of Yahweh would cringe before him,
and their punishment would last forever.

verses.text: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
lines: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat.
I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”
